$comment: Pinned upstream for JustSlide. Change only via scripts/engine/upstream-check.sh --propose + human review (docs/upstream-maintenance.md).

dependencySync.policy: gclient sync --revision src@<commit> --no-history -D; DEPS of the pinned commit are authoritative; never `gclient sync` without -r; never roll individual DEPS entries.
dependencySync.depotTools: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/tools/depot_tools.git (main at fetch time; recorded in out/<cfg>/justslide_provenance.json)

toolchain.clang: bundled by DEPS (third_party/llvm-build), not system clang
toolchain.rust: bundled by DEPS for Chromium; justslide-mcp uses rustup stable >= 1.88 (rmcp 3.9.0 MSRV)
toolchain.node: bundled by DEPS for Chromium WebUI tooling; JustSlide UI uses Bun 1.4.4
